recognition_trigger: When a length-returning function permits an empty collection, choose an accumulator identity that already represents no discovered elements.
corrected_rule: Initialize the global maximum run length to zero; update it only when a run is found.
why_failed: A positive initial maximum would incorrectly report a run for empty input, while zero is the correct neutral value for a maximum length.
application: An empty collection leaves the accumulator at 0. The set containing 8, 9, and 10 produces one run of length 3, so the accumulator becomes 3.
